raw_tokens.value: This gray stone carving of a gaunt older woman is usually painted with black hair and black clothing with red trim. Once per day, the bearer can use it to cast Stabilize, Resistance, and Virtue - this is usually enough to ensure that a mother and newborn both live through a difficult birth. If Pharasma is the bearer's patron: the bearer can use the icon to cast Augury once per day; as a standard action, the bearer can touch a pregnant woman and know whether she is carrying a boy or girl and whether it will be a single birth or multiple; once per day, the bearer can consecrate a corpse so if it is buried within 24 hours it cannot be reanimated as an undead.
